intro.title: useTransition
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Angular component that uses the `useTransition` hook to animate the visibility of a toggleable element. You will learn how to manage animation states and apply smooth transitions in response to user interactions. The core concepts involve Angular's built-in animation system, state management, and event handling. By the end, you'll understand how to create dynamic, engaging UI animations using Angular's declarative approach.
intro.usecase: The useTransition hook in Angular is essential for creating smooth, professional user interfaces during state changes. Developers use it in e-commerce filters where selecting categories triggers product list updates without jarring jumps, in dashboard panels that expand/collapse with fluid animations, and in multi-step forms where navigation between sections feels seamless. This pattern prevents abrupt UI shifts that frustrate users, making applications feel polished and responsive. Mastering useTransition allows you to build interfaces that meet modern user expectations for fluid interactions in real-world applications.
